question: Where can I find restaurant inside 100 kilometers while progressing from Tree That Owns Itself, Athens, GA toward AC Hotel, Atlanta, GA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-84.385904 33.786436)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.382376 33.955038)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
